title: useSelector
description: Learn how to read data from the Redux store.

data.text: **useSelector** lets you extract data from the Redux store. It subscribes to the store and re-renders when the selected data changes.

data.title: useSelector
Selectors
Shallow Equality
data.text: useSelector uses strict equality (===) by default. For objects, use shallowEqual from react-redux or return primitives.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: useSelector is the primary way to read Redux state.
